```{r}
#| label: mutate-tgdf
#| echo: false
#| include: false
tgdf <- tgdf %>%
    mutate(prev_rx = rx_csum - n_rx)

tgdf <- tgdf %>%
    mutate(size_class = factor(sz_clss, levels=c("No fire", "Class A", "Class B", "Class C", "Class D", "Class E", "Class F", "Class G"))) %>%
    mutate(size_class_pretty = recode(size_class, `Class A`="A", `Class B`="B", `Class C`="C", `Class D`="D", `Class E`="E", `Class F`="F", `Class G`="G"))
```


# Data and Data Engineering

## Data Inventory

<!-- PASTE FINAL TEXT -->

| Source | Role | License | Scope | Type | Size |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| LandMark | Indigenous & community land boundaries | Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0) | Global, current record | Simple features multipolygons | 11 OR records; ~2.1 GB total (global) |
| Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF) | Species occurence records for biodiversity/vegetation metrics | Open-data framework using CC0, CC BY, and CC BY-NC licenses | Oregon, 2015-2025 | Tabular with coordinates | 23571 records; ~14.6 MB |
| State of Oregon Historic Vegetation | Complementary vegetation record to distinguish between environment types | Creative Commons CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication) | Oregon, compiled historic record (1851-1910 and 1930) | Simple features multipolygons | 43,628 records; ~160 MB |
| NIFC InFORM Fire Occurrence Data Records (InFORM) | Fire occurrence records, including wildfires and prescribed burns | No formal open-data license identified; use and redistribution require careful consideration and source attribution | USA, 1922-2026 | Tabular with coordinates | 1221418 records; ~580 MB |
| NIFC Interagency Wildland Fire Perimeter History (IFPH) | Fire occurrence records, including wildfires and one prescribed burn | No formal open-data license identified; use and redistribution require careful consideration and source attribution | USA, 1668-2025 (includes historic record) | Simple features multipolygons | 4263 OR records, ~760 MB total (national) |

## Research Question 2

### Maximum Acres Burned Across Indigenous Land Categories

<!-- PASTE FINAL TEXT -->

```{r}
#| label: fig-max-acres-indigenous
#| fig-cap: "Maximum acres burned across land designation"
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 5

gdf %>%
    filter(max_acres > 0) %>%
    mutate(is_indigenous = ifelse(is_indigenous==1, "Indigenous", "Non-Indigenous")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(is_indigenous, max_acres, fill=is_indigenous)) +
    geom_boxplot(color="black", show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_y_log10(labels=scales::comma) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values=indigenous_cols) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
        x="",
        y="Maximum fire size by cell (acres)",
        title="Maximum acres burned for Indigenous \nvs non-Indigenous land",
        caption="n = 5139\nSource: InFORM, IFPH, LandMark"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text=element_text(size=10))

```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-indigenous-n-acres
#| tbl-cap: "Sample sizes for maximum fire size in Indigenous and non-Indigenous designated cells."
#| echo: false

ind_n_acres <- gdf %>% 
  filter(max_acres > 0) %>% 
  group_by(is_indigenous) %>%  
  summarize(`Number of Cells`=n()) %>% 
  mutate(`Indigenous Status`=ifelse(is_indigenous==0, "Non-Indigenous", "Indigenous"), .before=`Number of Cells`) %>% 
  select(-is_indigenous)
# NOTE:
# 226 Indigenous, 4913 non-indigenous
# may be better to display in the actual plot? can also be separate table as seen here

knitr::kable(ind_n_acres)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-rx-acres
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of fire size between cells that have or have not previously had prescribed burns."
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 3

plot(1, 1, type = "n", xlab = "", ylab = "", main = "Methods figure placeholder")
text(1, 1, "PLACEHOLDER")

# this should maybe be limited to 2022-2025
# i'm not sure. where the source code went. but it's the boxplot with max acres burned for cells w/without RX (also because it is time series. maybe should be. different than this. it's a little misleading I fear)

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-rx-annual-size-class
#| fig-cap: "Fire class distribution by presence of prescribed burn with Indigenous land designation status included as a support variable."
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 3

tgdf %>%
    filter(year > 2021) %>%
    mutate(
        had_rx = ifelse(prev_rx > 0, "Previous prescribed burns", "No previous prescribed burns"),
        has_rx = ifelse(rx_csum > 0, "Prescribed burns", "No prescribed burns"),
        is_ndgn = ifelse(is_ndgn==1, "Indigenous", "Not Indigenous"), 
        size_class_lim = fct_collapse(size_class_pretty, `C-E` = c("C", "D", "E"))
    ) %>%
    group_by(had_rx, size_class_lim, year) %>%
    summarize(n=n()) %>%
    group_by(had_rx, year) %>%
    mutate(
        total = sum(n),
        pct_sz = n/total
    ) %>%
    filter(size_class_lim != "No fire") %>%
    ggplot(aes(size_class_lim, pct_sz, fill=had_rx)) +
    geom_col(color="white", position="dodge") +
    facet_grid(~year) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=burn_cols) +
    labs(
        x="Maximum fire size class",
        y="Percent of cells (with/without prescribed burns)",
        title="Fire size distribution by presence of prescribed burn",
        fill="",
        #subtitle='"No fire" class not shown',
        caption='Source: InFORM, IFPH\n"No fire" class not shown. Cells without fires included in total for percentage.'
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position="top")

# should indicate sample size for this as well somewhere
```
